name: Verify keyboard navigation works for chat panel

steps.description: Use Tab key to navigate to the chat input field
steps.expectedResult: Chat input field receives focus via keyboard Tab

steps.description: Type a message using the keyboard
steps.expectedResult: Message text is entered in the input field

steps.description: Press Enter to send the message
steps.expectedResult: Message is sent successfully via Enter key

steps.description: Verify the entire chat interaction works via keyboard only
steps.expectedResult: All chat actions (focus, type, send) are fully accessible via keyboard without requiring mouse
